title: Newsroom UI for assisted curation triage review
description:
## Context
Epic kanbus-1f97c7 shipped a CLI-first assisted triage loop (`references triage-plan|triage-review|triage-auto-reject|triage-auto-rejects|triage-reverse-auto-reject`).

## Goal
Add a Newsroom desk surface for the same three-lane queue: rationale-first cards, cluster siblings, keyboard accept/reject/skip, lane filters, and session metrics. Must reuse the same plan/guarantees (no auto-accept; mechanical auto-rejects only via the logged path).

## Acceptance
- Operator can complete a review session without leaving Newsroom
- Accept still requires explicit human action
- Shows the same lane/rationale/cluster contract as the CLI plan JSON
